title: Students protest in Hyderabad demanding action against Agricultural University VC

tea.why: Students are protesting against the Vice-Chancellor of Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University over sexual harassment claims.
tea.want: They demand that the police register a case against the Vice-Chancellor following a complaint from an assistant professor.
tea.changed: Nov 11: Students held a midnight protest in Rajendranagar after alleging police failed to acknowledge a complaint against the Vice-Chancellor.

summary: Students at Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University held a midnight protest in Rajendranagar, Hyderabad, to demand that police register a formal case against Vice-Chancellor Prof. Aldas Janaiah. The protest followed allegations of sexual harassment made by an assistant professor, who claimed the Vice-Chancellor threatened her career. Protesters expressed frustration that police had not provided an acknowledgment receipt for the complaint. The assistant professor stated she had previously reported the matter to the Director General of Police, the Governor, and the Women's Wing. The Telangana State Commission for Women has issued a notice for the Vice-Chancellor to appear on November 12. Prof. Janaiah has denied the allegations, describing them as false and motivated by vindictiveness from individuals opposed to his university reforms in a letter to the Director General of Police.
demands: Register a police case against the Vice-Chancellor
response: The Vice-Chancellor dismissed the allegations as false and vindictive in a letter to the Director General of Police, claiming they were instigated by disgruntled staff members. The Telangana State Commission for Women has issued a notice to the VC.

updates.text: Students staged a midnight protest in Rajendranagar demanding police action against the university Vice-Chancellor.
